title: Wonderful afternoon spent with Marta
text: Marta, our guide for the Seville Cathedral and Giralda tower, was amazing! So informative, fun and eager to share all the beautiful history of such a magnificent place.  We loved spending the afternoon with her! Highly recommend
author: I7423DOpamelac

title: Seville Cathedral and Tower Tour - Magnifico!!
text: Carlos was knowledgeable and entertaining.  He was full of energy and kept the group interested, informed and entertained.  I would highly recommend this tour especially with Carlos!
author: stanh824

title: Highly recommended!
text: It was the best tour I had in Sevilla or even maybe the best I ever had in my life. Miguel is a monster of knowledge. He gave us tons of information and it's not that it was rehearsed information, Miguel is a live wikipedia about Spanish history. The site is beautiful, there are details and bits of history everywhere. The climb to the Giralda was fun too. I would highly recommend this activity, specially with Miguel.
author: Laurent_C

title: Great Tour
text: Carlos was fantastic! The cathedral was stunning and the walk up the tower wasn’t too strenuous.  We would highly recommend this tour- thanks very much.
author: W7900ZSkarenp

author: Ruchir_P

title: Fascinating tour and guide was great!
text: there were 7 of u son the tour so indeed a small group, at 4 pm start the cathedral was very busy and the walk up to the top of the Giralda a trek give all of the people … however after that the crowds thinned out a little and the rest of the two hours flew by. The history of the cathedral is fascinating and the building is spectacular, our guide Concha was very knowledgeable and as a local to Sevilla very passionate about her town and its history. Would very much reccomend
author: RichD1234

title: The Cathedral of Seville...
text: The Cathedral of Seville is a master peace and the guide "Valanteno" was very good, knowledgeable and speaks for good English.
author: ali_b

title: Fascinating and beautiful
text: I was very lucky to have a group of only 2 travellers with our guide, Carmen. She was fantastic and a real historian, I’m so grateful that I got to hear from her. Even at the end of a long and hot day, I loved it.
author: Kate_H

title: This small tour with Carmen is amazing
text: Carmen did an amazing job on our tour. We had a small group tour, and were able to learn a lot of history, fun facts and had all our questions answered. The tour was very personalized. We highly recommend booking this tour!
author: carriehN2681KC

title: The cathedral is...
text: The cathedral is breath-taking and there's too much to read about ahead of time. A knowledgeable guide always makes it worthwhile. Valentin is a historian and very knowledgeable. Even though we were the only ones who signed up, he still took us through the entire tour.
author: pg_P
